events.title: FOMC September rate decision (Sep 15-16)
events.why_it_matters: First FOMC under new Chair Kevin Warsh; rate hike odds jumped to ~50% after his hawkish Jackson Hole speech calling inflation 'concerning'.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Warsh delivers a hike to prove inflation-fighting credibility, or holds given soft July jobs data.

events.title: US August jobs report (Sep 4)
events.why_it_matters: July payrolls fell 23K (first negative print of cycle); August data will be decisive for whether the Fed hikes or holds in September.
events.what_to_watch: Consensus expects a rebound; a second weak print would likely kill September hike odds.

events.title: US CPI for August (Sep 11)
events.why_it_matters: July CPI eased to 3.4% annual; Warsh has signaled inflation remains 'concerning' and above target, making this print pivotal for the September hike call.
events.what_to_watch: Whether core inflation continues to cool toward 3% or re-accelerates, which would cement a hike.

events.title: ECB rate decision (Sep 10)
events.why_it_matters: Deposit rate at 2.25%; markets watching whether ECB cuts again amid eurozone weakness or holds given global inflation concerns.
events.what_to_watch: Lagarde's press conference for signals on the pace of easing into year-end.

events.title: Bank of Japan rate decision (Sep 17-18)
events.why_it_matters: BoJ held at 1.0% in July after hiking to 31-year high; normalization path continues with possible further hikes.
events.what_to_watch: Whether BoJ signals another hike given yen weakness and inflation persistence.

events.title: Canada retaliatory tariffs take effect (Sep 8)
events.why_it_matters: Canada will match US 50% tariffs on $20B of products 'dollar for dollar' starting Sept 8 after trade talks collapsed Aug 21; Carney says Canada is 'at war' over trade.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Trump escalates further or a last-minute deal emerges; impact on autos, lumber, agriculture.

events.title: Trump-Xi summit at White House (Sep 24)
events.why_it_matters: Xi's state visit to Washington; AI dominance expected to be central topic; trade truce extension 'almost certain' per SCMP.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a concrete AI or trade framework emerges; semiconductor export controls and tariff relief.

events.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan (Aug 31-Sep 1)
events.why_it_matters: Xi, Modi, Putin and Iran's Pezeshkian meet under one roof; signals on Russia-Ukraine, Iran war diplomacy, and de-dollarization.
events.what_to_watch: Any joint statements on Iran ceasefire, Ukraine, or energy cooperation that could move oil and EM markets.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings beat (Aug 26)
events.why_it_matters: Revenue $96.2B (+106% YoY), profit doubled to $59.7B; data center sales $89B as AI demand accelerates — confirms AI capex supercycle.
events.what_to_watch: Whether AI trade can sustain momentum into Broadcom and Dell earnings; any signs of demand digestion.

events.title: Broadcom Q3 earnings (Sep 2)
events.why_it_matters: AI chip bellwether after Nvidia's blowout; EPS est. $3.24, Wall Street's highest target $630; Jefferies optimistic on AI chip demand.
events.what_to_watch: AI revenue growth and custom silicon (ASIC) momentum; guidance for Q4.

events.title: Apple iPhone 18 event (Sep 9)
events.why_it_matters: First major product launch under new CEO John Ternus; 'Surprise and Shine' event expected to unveil iPhone 18 lineup.
events.what_to_watch: Pricing, AI features, and supply chain commentary; impact on Apple suppliers and consumer tech sentiment.

events.title: US national debt hits $40 trillion (Aug 18)
events.why_it_matters: Debt reached $40T months earlier than expected as bond yields rise; economists increasingly worried about fiscal sustainability and term premium.
events.what_to_watch: Treasury auction demand, long-end yield trajectory, and any fiscal policy response.

events.title: Jackson Hole: Warsh's hawkish debut speech (Aug 28)
events.why_it_matters: New Fed Chair Warsh called inflation 'concerning' and stayed quiet on rates, sending September hike odds higher and putting Fed 'at odds' with Treasury.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Warsh's hawkish stance translates into an actual September hike or is positioning.

events.title: China manufacturing PMI 49.8 (Aug 31)
events.why_it_matters: Factory activity shrank for second straight month (49.8, up from 49.2 but still below 50), keeping pressure on Beijing to support growth.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PBoC announces further stimulus ahead of Trump-Xi summit; impact on EM and commodity demand.

events.title: China M2/M1 money supply data (Aug 17)
events.why_it_matters: M2 up 7.7% YoY, M1 up 4%; PBoC expanded cross-border RMB operations for multinationals — modest easing signals.
events.what_to_watch: Whether credit impulse strengthens into Q4 and supports a growth stabilization narrative.

events.title: OPEC+ September output hike (Aug 2)
events.why_it_matters: OPEC+ approved 188K bpd September hike, completing rollback of 2023 voluntary cuts; adds supply amid Iran war volatility.
events.what_to_watch: Whether OPEC+ pauses further hikes given Iran war supply risk; oil price trajectory around $120.

events.title: US-Iran war: 6-month standoff, oil volatility (ongoing)
events.why_it_matters: US/Israel attacked Iran Feb 28; oil spiked to ~$120 before easing; talks deadlocked, shipping attacks continue — a persistent tail risk for energy and global markets.
events.what_to_watch: Any ceasefire breakthrough or escalation; Strait of Hormuz risk; refined products supply gap.

events.title: South Korea chip exports: 15th month of growth (Aug 28)
events.why_it_matters: August exports likely extended 15th consecutive month of growth (+62.6%), driven by AI chip demand; semiconductors ~half of exports.
events.what_to_watch: Whether AI-driven memory demand sustains into Q4; implications for Samsung, SK Hynix and global semis.

events.title: South Korea $3.5B semiconductor fund (Aug 10)
events.why_it_matters: Seoul launching 5T won fund for chip materials/parts/equipment/fabless firms; supports Korea's AI chip ambitions.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and which companies benefit; competitive dynamics vs Taiwan.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Sep 1)
events.why_it_matters: June ISM was 53.3 (6th straight expansion); August reading will gauge manufacturing resilience amid tariff uncertainty.
events.what_to_watch: Prices-paid sub-index for inflation signals; new orders for demand trajectory.

events.title: Dell and Palo Alto Networks earnings (Sep 2-3)
events.why_it_matters: AI infrastructure and cybersecurity bellwethers; will test whether AI demand breadth extends beyond Nvidia.
events.what_to_watch: AI server orders for Dell; Palo Alto's AI security product traction and guidance.

events.title: EO 14420/14421: National emergency to secure US bulk-power system
events.why_it_matters: Trump declared a national emergency under IEEPA authorizing DOE to prohibit foreign-produced bulk-power electric equipment (solar inverters, battery storage), hitting Chinese equipment suppliers and US clean-energy project costs.
events.what_to_watch: DOE licensing rules and which foreign manufacturers get targeted; impact on utility capex and solar/storage stocks.

events.title: SEC proposes 'Regulation Crypto Assets' framework
events.why_it_matters: First major SEC crypto rulemaking under Trump admin creating a tailored offering regime with exemptions up to $5M, a major clarity step for crypto markets.
events.what_to_watch: 60-day comment period and whether final rule broadens exemptions; crypto exchange and token issuer reaction.

events.title: Senate passes continuing resolution funding government through midterms
events.why_it_matters: Senate passed a bipartisan CR funding government through the November midterms, removing near-term shutdown risk; House must still pass it when Congress returns in September.
events.what_to_watch: House vote in September; any shutdown risk if House balks before Oct 1.

events.title: China MOFCOM countermeasures: drone export controls + 7 US entities sanctioned
events.why_it_matters: China's Commerce Ministry imposed case-by-case drone export reviews to the US and sanctioned 7 US entities, escalating tech/trade tensions ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.
events.what_to_watch: Whether drone export curbs expand to other dual-use items; impact on US drone and supply-chain stocks.

events.title: Trump signs EO creating US Space Academy
events.why_it_matters: Executive order establishing a US Space Academy to train space workforce, supporting the commercial space and defense industrial base.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and funding; space/defense contractor beneficiaries.

events.title: Trump signs EO renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid Canada trade war
events.why_it_matters: Symbolic escalation in the US-Canada trade war, signaling no near-term de-escalation before Canada's Sep 8 retaliatory tariffs take effect.
events.what_to_watch: Canada's response and whether trade talks resume before Sep 8 tariffs.

events.title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment falls to 51.0, inflation expectations 4.0%
events.why_it_matters: Consumer sentiment fell ~6% MoM to 51.0 with year-ahead inflation expectations at 4.0%, reinforcing Warsh's hawkish inflation concern and September hike odds.
events.what_to_watch: Whether September sentiment continues to deteriorate; Fed reaction to inflation expectations.

events.title: Japan Q2 GDP grows 1.1% annualized, missing estimates
events.why_it_matters: Japan Q2 GDP missed 2.0% consensus (1.1% annualized), with weak domestic demand, complicating BoJ's normalization path ahead of its Sep 17-18 decision.
events.what_to_watch: BoJ reaction to weak growth; yen and Nikkei direction.

events.title: Eurozone flash PMI: manufacturing hits 4-year high (52.8)
events.why_it_matters: Eurozone manufacturing PMI rose to 52.8 (51-month high) driven by German AI-related tech goods, tempering ECB easing bets ahead of the Sep 10 decision.
events.what_to_watch: ECB rate decision Sep 10; whether stronger growth delays a cut.

events.title: China holds 1-year LPR at 3% for 13th month
events.why_it_matters: PBoC held LPRs steady despite manufacturing contraction, signaling reluctance to ease aggressively; keeps pressure on Beijing to support growth.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PBoC cuts rates at September LPR meeting given weak PMI.

events.title: CrowdStrike Q2 FY2027 earnings beat, raises guidance
events.why_it_matters: CrowdStrike topped estimates and raised annual revenue forecast as AI threats mount, popping 11%+ and confirming cybersecurity as an AI tailwind.
events.what_to_watch: Investor briefing Sep 2; whether AI agent proliferation sustains cybersecurity demand.

events.title: Salesforce Q2 FY2027 record results, surges 23% on Anthropic partnership
events.why_it_matters: Salesforce delivered record Q2 results and announced an Anthropic partnership, sending shares up 23% and confirming AI software demand breadth beyond Nvidia.
events.what_to_watch: Whether AI software momentum extends to other cloud names; enterprise AI adoption signals.

events.title: Deere Q3 earnings: raises 2026 profit view on AI construction boom
events.why_it_matters: Deere raised its 2026 profit outlook as AI-driven construction demand offset continued farm weakness, a bellwether for the industrial/ag equipment cycle.
events.what_to_watch: Whether farm recovery materializes in 2027 as Deere guided; construction capex sustainability.

events.title: TJX and Ross Stores off-price retail earnings
events.why_it_matters: Ross beat with 10% comp growth while TJX's Marmaxx slowdown clouded its beat, signaling divergent consumer spending and off-price dynamics amid tariff-driven inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Consumer discretionary spending trends into holiday season; tariff impact on retail margins.

events.title: RBNZ rate decision (Sep 2)
events.why_it_matters: RBNZ MPS meeting with updated projections after July hike to 2.50%; markets watching for hold, hike, or cut signals.
events.what_to_watch: OCR decision and updated economic projections.

events.title: China deploys record number of ships near Taiwan
events.why_it_matters: China's record maritime deployment near Taiwan raises cross-strait tension ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, a tail risk for tech supply chains.
events.what_to_watch: Escalation trajectory into September; summit impact on Taiwan rhetoric.

events.title: US industrial production rises below expectations in July
events.why_it_matters: US industrial production ticked up but below expectations in July, with manufacturing capacity utilization edging higher — a mixed signal for the Fed.
events.what_to_watch: September ISM and whether manufacturing momentum holds.

events.title: EIA weekly crude inventories: modest build
events.why_it_matters: US crude inventories rose 0.1M bbl in a modest build, providing limited relief to oil prices still elevated near $120 on Iran war risk.
events.what_to_watch: Whether inventory builds continue; OPEC+ supply and Iran war trajectory.

events.title: Russia sanctions bill: House vote expected in September
events.why_it_matters: Senate advanced sweeping Russia sanctions legislation; House vote expected in September amid 'moment of extreme urgency' in Ukraine, potentially hitting energy and Russian-linked assets.
events.what_to_watch: House passage timing and scope of sanctions; energy market reaction.

top_risks: Fed rate hike in September after Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech
US-Canada trade war escalation with retaliatory tariffs effective Sep 8
US-Iran war ongoing with oil price volatility around $120
US national debt at $40T pressuring bond yields
China manufacturing contraction for second straight month
Potential for hawkish surprise from ECB or BoJ
top_opportunities: AI chip demand supercycle confirmed by Nvidia blowout, benefiting Broadcom, Dell, and memory makers
South Korea chip export boom and semiconductor fund support
Potential US-China trade truce at Trump-Xi summit Sep 24
OPEC+ output hike easing oil supply concerns
Apple iPhone 18 launch driving consumer tech cycle
summary: The market enters September with elevated uncertainty centered on the Fed's first rate decision under new Chair Kevin Warsh, whose hawkish Jackson Hole speech has pushed September hike odds to ~50%. Key US data (jobs report Sep 4, CPI Sep 11) will be decisive. Geopolitical risks are elevated: US-Canada trade war escalates with tariffs effective Sep 8, US-Iran war continues with oil around $120, and the Trump-Xi summit Sep 24 looms. AI trade remains the dominant bullish force after Nvidia's blowout, with Broadcom and Dell earnings this week as the next test. China's manufacturing contraction adds to global growth concerns. Overall, a high-impact week ahead with multiple macro catalysts.

catcher.coverage_assessment: The primary scan covered macro data, earnings, and geopolitical events well, but was blind to nearly all government actions — missing multiple executive orders, the SEC crypto rulemaking, the Senate funding bill, and China's countermeasures. It also missed several second-tier macro prints (UMich sentiment, Japan GDP, Eurozone PMI) and second-tier earnings (CrowdStrike, Salesforce, Deere, TJX/Ross).
catcher.biggest_gap: EO 14420/14421 declaring a national emergency to secure the US bulk-power system (Aug 26) — a major IEEPA-based action restricting foreign-produced power equipment that directly hits utilities, solar/storage, and Chinese suppliers, and was entirely absent from the primary scan.
